content:
Listen on Podbean

Guest Stan, a dentist and dental lab owner, shares his journey from a stage 3C cancer diagnosis to recovery after choosing the Hippocrates Health Institute’s holistic program over conventional treatment. He credits a raw-food diet, psychotherapy, stress-reframing, and total commitment for rapid improvements in energy, weight, and well-being.

The episode explores the health risks of dental chemical exposure, Stan’s immigration and global background, and practical lifestyle changes (including dehydrated/raw food preparation) that helped him heal. Listeners hear hopeful advice about prevention, education, and the power of mindset in restoring health at Hippocrates.
